summary: Revenue fell 67.3% to $2.0M in 2025. The operating loss widened to $178M from $102M.
The net loss widened to $162M, or −$4.20 per share, from $85.0M. Operating cash flow was −$129M and free cash flow −$129M, versus −$78.3M.
sources: Dianthus Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
